newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bordeaux air cargo traffic up two pct in Jan-Nov.
newsitem.headline: Bordeaux air cargo traffic up two pct in Jan-Nov.

text.p: Bordeaux's Merignac airport said it handled 7,496 tonnes of air cargo traffic in the first eleven months of 1996, up two percent on the same period last year.
In September 1996, United Parcel Service ), launched a weekday feeder service between Lyon-Satolas airport and Bordeaux using two-tonne capacity Beechcraft 1900 aircraft.
Bordeaux is also part of DHL's Worldwide Express' weekday Brussels-western France flight. This Brussels-Nantes-Bordeaux service uses a 6.5 tonnes-capacity Convair aircraft.
Airfreight is also carried in the bellyholds of passenger aircraft operating domestic, European and long-haul services from Bordeaux.
Postal traffic totalled 11,847 tonnes, an increase of 21 percent on 1995 levels.

French airline, L'Aeropostale, carries overnight mail between its Paris-Charles de Gaulle hub and Bordeaux on a regular basis using a Boeing 737QC aircraft. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
